title: Design: Close window notes parts cost is not posted without inventory accounts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Use a location connected to QuickBooks Online where Inventory Asset is not mapped.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer with every line Complete, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-21-7f-close-quickbooks-without-inventory-accounts.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the internal work order.
  2. Click Close Work Order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The parts rows carry the note of the PRD for a location without inventory accounts instead of an account name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync)

  • S3-N4: “At a QuickBooks location without Inventory Asset or Cost of Parts, the parts rows carry the note of S7-N5 instead.”
  • S7-N5: “If Inventory Asset or Cost of Parts is not mapped at the location, no parts entry is sent at Close (stock parts and reclass entries), as invoicing sends none today for that location: the inventory journal entries need both accounts, so a shop that keeps no inventory in QuickBooks is never credited on Inventory Asset by Close alone. The shop supplies entry of S7-R4a still posts. The Close confirmation shows on the Stock parts and Special orders rows the note "Parts cost is not posted to QuickBooks at this location: inventory accounts are not mapped."”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
